{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(internal_test_orders)}")

# Confirm the premises:
assert len(internal_test_orders) == 6, "Expected exactly 6 internal test orders"
assert df['revenue'].dtype == 'object', "Revenue should be string type"

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the final value
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
